editorial:
Imagine getting a million dollars just for staying around people. That is the wild setup you get here. You follow a guy who enters a deadly game where hunters try to kill him, but there is a catch: they can only strike when he is completely alone. It sounds easy until you realize that nobody in his life believes he is actually in danger. You will feel his panic as he begs strangers to hang out with him just to stay alive. The vibe is a weird mix of a stressful thriller and a goofy comedy that keeps you guessing about what is real.

Jake Johnson does a great job playing the lead, making you really feel his desperation. The pacing is quick, and the way the movie handles the tension is impressive. While some of the plot twists might feel a bit strange, the humor makes up for it. If you like movies that make you laugh while you sweat, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: At the end, you find out the game is more about social control than just money. The main character manages to survive by finding real connections with others, which breaks the cycle of isolation the hunters rely on. He eventually faces the people running the game and realizes the whole thing was a test of his will. He wins the money and survives, but he learns that being alone is the scariest part of all.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves dark comedies and survival stories.
